_comment: CityWorld override of BoP's own file. BoP places this with count 6 over a height_range spanning the whole dimension, which is tuned for vanilla's 128-block Nether. The ruined-city Nether is full height (-64..319), about 3x taller, so the same 6 attempts scatter over 3x the column and nearly all land in solid rock or open sky: measured 6 rose quartz blocks across a 13x13-chunk sweep, i.e. the pillars the owner reported missing. Count is left at BoP's own 6 - only the band is aimed at where the caves actually are. Measured: 75 blocks, all covered, 44 of them carrying quartz directly above and below (real columns).
_comment2: The condition is NOT optional. This file names a BoP configured feature, and without BoP that reference is unbound: the whole registry load fails and the SERVER REFUSES TO START (on this line the keys are forge:conditions / forge:mod_loaded) ('Unbound values in registry minecraft:worldgen/configured_feature', 'Failed to load datapacks, can't proceed with server load'). Measured 2026-09-16 — it killed the self-test on both branches that have no BoP in run/mods. A dangling feature reference is fatal, unlike a dangling tag entry which is merely dropped.
